name: product-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the product-domain disciplines in one install — payments and billing (idempotent webhooks, money handling, ledgers), internationalization (ICU MessageFormat, Intl, RTL), and LLM application engineering (evals, RAG, prompt-injection defense). Uninstall cleanly with /product-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
